remarks: This newly renovated ranch-style house is where modern luxury meets effortless living. This 3 bedroom, 1 bathroom provides a bright and sophisticated atmosphere. The kitchen has white cabinetry, granite countertops, glossy contemporary black tiles, and new appliances. There are hardwood floors flow throughout. The sun-drenched living room has a fireplace and triple-window views, while the dining area boasts an orb chandelier and dramatic teal walls. There are 3 bedrooms, including a master bedroom. The master bedroom offers ample closet space and a dark-toned aesthetic for relaxation. The bathroom has both a tub and a marble standing shower. Enjoy the outdoors on the wood deck, which is attached to the kitchen and overlooks a spacious backyard, ideal for summer grilling. The house includes in-unit washer/dryer, off-street parking for two cars and maintenance-free living (snow removal and grounds maintenance included!). Situated on the vibrant High Ridge Road, you are very close to grocery shopping- Trader Joe's, Whole Foods and ACME. You have instant access to the Merritt Parkway (Exit 35) and I-95. The 331 bus line stops nearby or you can drive a few moments to the Metro North. You are minutes from the energy of downtown Stamford, with its famous dining, theatre and college scene. Close to Davenport Ridge Elementary and Westhill High. Lastly, you are close to Scalzi Park, local health clubs and medical facilities.
